sourceRecords.title: CBAM calculation and attribution methods
sourceRecords.scope: IR 2025/2547, Articles 3–6: system boundaries, functional units, monitoring plan and attribution. Article 4(5) uses tonnes of clinker contained in specified cement goods. Direct-only simulated E is not a full CBAM embedded-emissions result.

sourceRecords.title: TR-ETS pilot procedures
sourceRecords.scope: Pilot procedures: Articles 2–4 define covered facilities, plans and reports; Article 11 sets weighted benchmarks per relevant sub-installation, with separate electricity rules; Article 12 applies allocation calculations and adjustments. This project implements aggregation evidence, not these complete allocation rules.

sourceRecords.title: OpenZeppelin cryptography utilities
sourceRecords.scope: ECDSA.tryRecover exposes the recovered address, recovery error and an additional diagnostic argument. MerkleProof verifies membership of a leaf in a sorted-pair hash tree; project leaves use the matching StandardMerkleTree encoding.

sourceRecords.title: IPCC 2006 Vol 2 Ch 2 stationary combustion
sourceRecords.scope: Table 2.3 manufacturing and construction: kg CO2/TJ on a net calorific basis. Petroleum coke 97500 (82900-115000); other bituminous coal 94600 (89500-99700); natural gas 56100 (54300-58300); lignite 101000 (90900-115000). These are defaults, not plant-specific measured factors.

sourceRecords.title: IPCC 2006 Vol 3 Ch 2 mineral industry
sourceRecords.scope: Clinker rather than cement production is needed for clinker process CO2. CaO origin, non-carbonate inputs, CKD, MgO, and carbon capture affect methodology. Tier 2 and 3 account for CKD. A simple carbonate stoichiometric plausibility check does not constitute a complete monitoring methodology.

sourceRecords.title: EU cement BAT conclusions, Decision 2013/163/EU
sourceRecords.scope: Section 1.2.3 Table 1: 2900-3300 MJ/tonne clinker is a BAT-associated energy consumption range for new plants and major upgrades using dry-process multistage preheating and precalcination, subject to raw-material moisture and footnotes. It is not a universal physical feasibility band.

sourceRecords.title: IPCC cement production background paper
sourceRecords.scope: Section 2.2.1 gives EF_clinker = fractionCaO * (44.01 g/mol CO2 / 56.08 g/mol CaO). It discusses non-carbonate CaO, lost CKD, clinker imports/exports, confidential information and external review. Do not use its historical activity data as a current fact.

sourceRecords.title: Ollama structured outputs
sourceRecords.scope: Local /api/chat accepts stream:false and a JSON schema in format; responses contain message.content, which must be parsed and schema validated. Passing the schema in the prompt and temperature 0 is recommended. JSON schema constraints do not establish factual extraction accuracy.

sourceRecords.title: ISO 14064-1:2018 public scope
sourceRecords.scope: Organisation-level GHG quantification, reporting and inventory management. Programme-specific requirements remain additional. Public scope only; no licensed clause text or conformance certification.

sourceRecords.title: ISO 14064-3:2019 public scope
sourceRecords.scope: Principles and requirements for validation/verification of organisation, project and product GHG statements. Programme requirements remain additional; a cryptographic signature is not a verification engagement.

sourceRecords.title: ISO 14065:2020 public scope
sourceRecords.scope: Requirements for bodies validating/verifying environmental information; a sector application of ISO/IEC 17029:2019. Correct designation is ISO 14065, not ISO/IEC 14065. An allowlisted public key establishes no accreditation.

sourceRecords.title: Wüst and Gervais, Do you need a Blockchain?
sourceRecords.scope: Original decision framework, Section III and Figure 1: storage, multiple writers, acceptable online trusted party, writer trust/identity and public verifiability. Known mutually distrusting writers can fit a public permissioned design; public permissionless settlement is a separate project choice.

sourceRecords.title: Gazetted Türkiye Emissions Trading System Regulation
sourceRecords.scope: Regulation published 27 August 2026 in Official Gazette 33353. Covers MRV and ETS responsibilities; defines accreditation and sub-installations. A simulated public-key allowlist is not a TÜRKAK accreditation check.

sourceRecords.title: DoCC announcement of pilot procedures
sourceRecords.scope: Announcement dated 1 October 2026 says procedures were approved on 30 September 2026, approval 18626; cites the board meeting of 15 January 2026 (KPK/2026/1), distinct from the 3 September announcement. Pilot system years 2026–2027; reporting only in 2026 and first surrender for 2027 emissions.

steps: All incoming points and aggregate point sums
Every published trustee sum against VSS commitments

limitations: SIMULATED reports, inputs, actors, keys, trustees and sector denominator; same-host operation.
Arithmetic and signatures do not establish report truth, accreditation or regulatory acceptance.
Two colluding trustees can reconstruct individual plants; endpoint compromise can expose openings.
Aggregate subtraction by other plants and overlapping/repeated cohorts can disclose individual information.
Each issued threshold badge reveals a comparison bit; the bound is per round, not a global query budget.
ECDSA, Groth16, commitment binding and X25519 transport have classical assumptions; this is not a fully post-quantum system.
ML-DSA co-signatures are checked off-chain. The single project setup contribution has no independent production audit.
Coverage uses a simulated declared denominator. The representative flag is a protocol policy, not official population assurance.
The generic aggregate is not a complete CBAM or TR-ETS monitoring, attribution, assurance or allocation methodology.
Online reproduction trusts the independently selected deployment anchor, frontend/source build and RPC; it is not a light-client finality proof.
Offline reproduction checks arithmetic and signatures only; it does not authenticate chain history.
A local or testnet deployment does not establish institutional participation, physical-phone measurement or real emissions reduction.
